text:
maya: Ok dropping the bring-up notes for cormorant-13B-v1 quant plan. TL;DR: try fp8 -> int8 hybrid (gguf) with per-channel calibration, evaluate LAMBADA + MMLU subsets + embedding drift. Want owners and a short smoke checklist.

simon: thanks. quick priorities? latency vs quality?

maya: priority order: 1) quality floor (no >2% LAMBADA delta), 2) latency within 1.3x baseline, 3) cost. If tradeoffs require >2% drop, fallback to fp8-only.

elaine: i'll own the calibration data and eval harness. will prepare 3 calibration sets: 
- small: 1k in-domain sampling traces
- mixed: 5k diverse prompts (code, conv, wiki)
- long-tail: 2k long-context prompts (>=1024 tokens)

jordan: i'll run the kernel perf and gguf build. planning experiments:
- baseline full fp16 (no quant)
- fp8 per-layer (APEX-like)
- int8 per-channel symmetric + outlier clipping
- hybrid fp8 (first+last layers fp16/fp8, middle fp8)
- gguf quantized file with KV cache preserved

maya: add an activation histogram dump step during sampling. want to inspect outliers before committing scale factors.

quant-bot: Recommended command for calibration run:
```bash
python tools/calibrate.py \\  --model weights/cormorant-13B-v1.pt \\  --calib-set data/calib/mixed.jsonl \\  --outdir runs/cormorant-calib/mixed \\  --layers per_channel --collect-activations
```

simon: small smoke results (local VM, single A100):
- fp16 baseline: LAMBADA acc 0.512, avg latency 220ms/token
- fp8 per-layer: LAMBADA acc 0.504 (-1.6%), latency 190ms/token (0.86x)
- int8 symmetric: LAMBADA acc 0.487 (-4.9%), latency 160ms/token (0.73x)
- gguf-hybrid build size: fp16 55GB -> fp8 28GB -> int8 14GB

elaine: embedding cosine drift (baseline vs quant): fp8 mean cos=0.995, int8 mean cos=0.978. MMLU macro accuracy: fp16 0.72, fp8 0.715 (-0.7%), int8 0.698 (-2.2%).

maya: int8 looks marginal on quality, passes cost/latency but fails quality floor. fp8 looks promising. Next: run per-layer sensitivity to see which layers are brittle. jordan can you run layerwise kl/mse sweep?

jordan: on it. plan: per-layer large-step quant test using 128 samples, measure delta logprobs and token-level error. will push artifacts to runs/cormorant-layer-sweep/ by EOD.

quant-bot: suggestion: for long-context degradation, enable KV-symmetric clipping and run prefix-caching checks. Example config snippet:
```json
{
  "quant_profile": "hybrid-gguf",
  "clip_method": "kv_symmetric",
  "preserve_kv": true
}
```

elaine: checklist for bring-up (short):
- [ ] collect calibration sets (maya/elaine)
- [ ] dump activations + histograms (jordan)
- [ ] run per-layer sensitivity (jordan)
- [ ] build gguf variants (jordan)
- [ ] run smoke evals: LAMBADA, MMLU-subset, embedding drift (simon/elaine)
- [ ] perf baseline and latency SLO test (jordan/ops-bot)
- [ ] decide default profile and fallback policy (maya/simon)

maya: ownership and deadlines: calibration data by tomorrow 10am -> elaine; layer sweep by EOD -> jordan; smoke evals by tomorrow noon -> simon+elaine. I'll synthesize a recommendation and PR for the model catalog by tomorrow 4pm.

ops-bot: scheduled job created: job/quant-calib-1799172340 starts 2026-06-05T03:00:00Z (approx).

simon: small note: watch for tokenization differences between fp16 run and gguf loader; we saw subtle tokenization-gap in previous model. add a tokenizer roundtrip check.

maya: good call. add to checklist. Also capture sample generations for manual review (5 examples per eval, include failure cases).

elaine: added. I'll include a small prompt set with sensitive tokens to detect degeneration.

jordan: layer sweep quick note: layers 1-3 show high activation kurtosis -> likely needs outlier-aware scale. will try quantile clipping and median-of-means scaling.

maya: decision logic draft: if fp8 LAMBADA delta <=2% and embedding cos >=0.990 -> default fp8-gguf; else if hybrid fp8-first/last reduces delta to <=2% -> use hybrid; else keep fp16 for hosted, expose int8 for dedicated cost-tiers only.

simon: ack. I'll start a PR template with the decision matrix and expected perf numbers.

maya: thanks team. We'll reconvene after runs finish. reaction: :rocket:
